g.title: cluster_turn
g.text: REQUEST LIFECYCLE · read top to bottom

g.title: Prepare
g.text: PromptBuilder: recalled memory / skills / lessons / policy

g.title: Execute
g.text: Loop + Registry + Dispatch: repeat tool / observation turns
Extrospection on demand; auto baseline: host / repo / env

g.title: Verify
g.text: Authored checks + complete original obligation coverage

g.title: Account
g.text: Reward + Learning: judge claim != verified completion

g.title: Retain
g.text: Policy accounting + ranking: positive training credit
SkillReview: recommend by default; limited auto-safe SOP edits

g.title: Reuse
g.text: PromptBuilder recalls retained context as budget permits
This closes the context loop, not a proof of improvement
TaskSummarizer compass is UX, never acceptance

g.title: Select
g.text: Read recorded policy state, not live online writers
No automatic handoff from the request lifecycle

g.title: Regression
g.text: Exact request digest + operator-authored file / JSON gold
Inert regression recipe; never relabel as held-out

g.title: Evaluate
g.text: Off / baseline / candidate; public fixed held-out tasks
Regression replay stays separate from held-out evidence

g.title: Promote
g.text: Approval + stopped writers + explicit live policy target

g.title: Receipt
g.text: Digest-bound rollback refuses intervening live writes
No claim of general live LLM improvement

g.title: Promote->Receipt
g.text: only after approval and passing gates

g.title: Trainer
g.text: Curriculum export / configured trainer is opt-in
Not routing-policy promotion or proof of adapter gains
Scheduled curriculum jobs are disabled by default
